body_lead: UP Budget 2026: Yogi govt bets big on capex, rural push and AI mission Capital expenditure accounts for 19.5% of the total outlay, reinforcing the state’s infrastructure-led growth strategy, while the fiscal deficit has been projected at 3 per cent of GSDP. Set ETGovernment as your preferred source on Google Lucknow: The Uttar Pradesh government on Tuesday presented an expansionary yet fiscally disciplined Budget for FY 2026–27, stepping up capital expenditure, rural infrastructure and social sector allocations while committing to keep the fiscal deficit at 3 per cent of GSDP.
